subject: World Screen
text: The World Screen displays the player's Hit Points (HP), Magic Points (MP), and Gold (G).

evidence.quote:
| HP= Hit Points  |
| MP= Magic Points|
| G= Gold         |

subject: HP
text: When the HP value drops to zero, the player will die.

evidence.quote:
Current HP- The HP value shown on the bottom left of the screen shows
how much HP you currently have. Once this value drops to zero you will
die.

subject: MP
text: When the MP value drops to zero, the player cannot cast any more spells.

evidence.quote:
Current MP- The MP value shown on the bottom middle of the screen shows
how much MP you currently have. Once this value drops to zero you will
not be able to cast any more spells.

subject: Gold
text: Gold is the monetary standard in Final Fantasy Adventure.

evidence.quote:
Gold is the monetary standard in
Final Fantasy Adventure.

subject: Attack Gauge
text: Once the Attack Gauge is full, the player can use their MAX Attack.

evidence.quote:
Attack Gauge- This gauge measures your attack power. Once the gauge is
full you can use your MAX Attack.

subject: Menu Screen- 2
text: Pressing Start opens Menu Screen- 2 for Item, Magic, Equip, and ASK.

evidence.quote:
Menu Screen- 2 (Item/Magic/Equip/ASK)
-------------------------------------

-> Press Start to open this screen.

subject: Status
text: The Status box displays the player's condition: Good, Poison, Moogle, Stone, or Darkness.

evidence.quote:
Status- This box displays your condition: Good, Poison, Moogle, Stone,
or Darkness.

subject: Controls
text: Pressing the B button uses the equipped Magic or Item, and pressing the A button uses the equipped weapon.

evidence.quote:
To use the
Magic or Item that you have equipped, press the B button. To use your
weapon, press the A button.

subject: Item Sub-Menu
text: The Item Sub-Menu contains only 16 Items slots.

evidence.quote: -There are only 16 Items slots.

subject: Item Sub-Menu
text: To select an item, press the A button twice, and to use the item, press the B button once.

evidence.quote:
Using an Item:
You can move the cursor to different items my moving the directional
pad. To select the item of your choice, press the A button twice. To
use the item, press the B button once.

subject: Trash Can
text: Discarding an item into the Trash Can removes it from the screen, and it cannot be retrieved.

evidence.quote:
Move this cursor to the Trash Can and press the A button. The item will
now disappear from the screen.
*NOTE* Once an item has been placed in the Trash Can, you will not be
able to get it back from the Trash Can.

subject: Magic Sub-Menu
text: There are only eight magic spells in the game: Cure, Fire, Slep, Heal, Ice, Mute, Lit, and Nuke.

evidence.quote:
- Magic Sub-Menu -
------------------
    _____________
   | Cure   Fire |
   | Slep   Heal |
   | Ice    Mute |
   | Lit    Nuke |
   +-------------+

-There are only eight magic spells in the game.

subject: Magic
text: Pressing the A button equips a selected spell, and pressing the B button casts it unless MP is insufficient.

evidence.quote:
To use Magic, move the cursor to the desired magic spell. Now press the
A button once. This will equip your magic. To cast your magic spell,
press the B button. However, if you do not have sufficient MP to use
the spell, the magic will not be cast.

subject: Magic
text: To prevent accidentally casting a spell and wasting MP, exchange equipped magic with an item that cannot be operated accidentally by pressing the B button.

evidence.quote:
To remove the magic
spell that you are equipped with, you should exchange the magic with
any item that cannot be operated accidentally by pressing the B button.

subject: Equipment Sub-Menu
text: The Equipment Sub-Menu displays equipped Weapon, Helmet, Armor, and Shield, along with character Attack Power (AP) and Defense Power (DP).

evidence.quote:
Weapon- The Weapon that you currently have.
Helmet- The Helmet that you currently have equipped.
Armor- The Armor that you currently have equipped.
Shield- The Shield that you currently have equipped.
AP- Characters current attack power.
DP- Characters current defense power.

subject: Equipment
text: Certain weapons cannot be discarded into the Trash Can to prevent losing weapons needed to complete the game.

evidence.quote:
You can discard some of your weapons, but there are some weapons that
you are unable to get rid of. This helps to prevent people from selling
specific weapons, or types of weapons with which they need to complete
the game.

subject: ASK Command
text: The ASK command lets the player ask an NPC currently in their group for help.

evidence.quote:
This command will let you ASK a NPC, if one is currently in your group
for help. NPC's can help you in various and important ways, so always
check to see what your NPC says or can do for you.

subject: Menu Screen- 3
text: Pressing Select opens Menu Screen- 3, which provides access to Save, Map, and Status sub-menus.

evidence.quote:
Menu Screen- 3 (Save/Map/Status)
--------------------------------

-> Press Select to open this screen.

subject: Save Sub-Menu
text: Players have 2 different possible records with which they can save their game.

evidence.quote:
-> You have 2 different possible records with which you can save your
game.

subject: Save Sub-Menu
text: Each save record displays the character's Name, current and maximum HP and MP, Level (L), and current experience alongside experience needed to advance (E).

evidence.quote:
Name- The name of your character will appear here.
HP- The current / maximum amount of HP will be listed here.
MP The current / maximum amount of MP will be listed here.
L- The level of your character will be listed here.
E- Your current amount of experience will be listed on top / the amount
of experience that your character needs to advance to the next level.

subject: Map Sub-Menu
text: Outside of dungeons, the general map gives a broad idea of the world, while in a dungeon it displays the dungeon's rooms and entrances, updating as each new room is entered.

evidence.quote:
The general map that is called up when you are NOT in a
dungeon is very general, only showing giving you a very broad idea of
the world. When in a dungeon, the rooms displayed will be those of the
dungeon only. Each time you enter a new room, the cave map will be
updated with the new information. The dungeon maps are much more
intricate. Dungeon maps will show you the entrances to different rooms.

subject: Map Sub-Menu
text: One grid on the map represents one screen, and only explored rooms are displayed.

evidence.quote: -> One grid on the map will always represent one screen....- Only the rooms that have been explored are displayed.
